dataset.title: Experimental data
dataset.description: Data related to each of our proposed experiments. These will include the detailed protocols used for each experiment, the raw data collected from each experiment, and the experimental code used to collect those data.

distribution.title: Experimental data distribution
distribution.description: Data will be made available upon request, after the conclusion of each of study.

metadata.description: The contents of each data file, including the experimental conditions or the analysis procedures used during generation will be documented.

dataset.title: Analysis code and results

distribution.title: Analysis code and results distribution
distribution.description: Code needed to generate all published results will be documented clearly.

dataset.title: Simulation code
dataset.description: Substantial simulation code for controller development and testing.

distribution.title: Simulation code distribution
